classification: DIAGNOSTIC EVIDENCE — NOT MACHINE REJECTION RULE
importantNote: These findings are diagnostic evidence from a 22-image sample. They are NOT directly instantiated as machine rejection rules. The actual Phase 2.4 Anti-Pattern Gate must be derived from Phase 1 Anti-Pattern Grammar + Phase 2 Observable Evidence, not from this diagnostic report alone.

antiPatterns.name: Vermilion Circular Sun Template
antiPatterns.description: Identical or near-identical vermilion circular sun motif placed in upper portion of composition, repeated across multiple images with minimal variation in size, color, or position.

diagnosticEvidence.visualSignature: Perfect circle, RGB approximately (220-240, 40-70, 30-50), positioned in upper 1/3 of frame
diagnosticEvidence.variationRange: Minimal — size varies ±15%, position varies ±10% horizontally
diagnosticEvidence.culturalContext: While red sun is a legitimate Chinese aesthetic motif (红日), the mechanical repetition without compositional integration indicates template usage rather than intentional design.

phase24GateInput.detectionMethod: Circular Hough transform + color histogram matching in upper frame region
phase24GateInput.threshold: If >3 images in a candidate batch share identical sun signature, flag batch as template-contaminated
phase24GateInput.rejectionAction: REJECT for golden case promotion; ALLOW as decorative reference with explicit annotation

antiPatterns.name: Mechanical Aerial Composition Template
antiPatterns.description: 'Aerial/isometric view + cloud sea filling middle frame + architecture positioned in bottom-right quadrant' composition repeated across multiple images.

diagnosticEvidence.visualSignature: High camera angle (~45-60° elevation), cloud sea occupying 40-60% of frame height, architecture bounding box centered in bottom-right quadrant
diagnosticEvidence.compositionVariation: Low — horizon line consistently at 40-50% height, architecture consistently in right half

phase24GateInput.detectionMethod: Horizon line detection + architecture bounding box quadrant analysis + camera elevation estimation from vertical convergence
phase24GateInput.threshold: If >50% of candidate batch shares identical quadrant placement, flag as composition-template
phase24GateInput.rejectionAction: DEMERIT for spatial diversity score; NOT hard reject unless combined with other template markers

antiPatterns.name: AI Plastic Highlight Material Response
antiPatterns.description: Over-saturated specular highlights with uniform plastic-like material response, lacking physically coherent roughness variation across different material types (wood, stone, metal, tile).

occurrence.affectedCount: multiple (exact count pending Phase 2.2 material evidence extraction)

diagnosticEvidence.visualSignature: High-luminance (>200) low-saturation (<30) pixel clusters with sharp local gradient transitions, uniform across wood/stone/roof surfaces
diagnosticEvidence.materialFailure: All surface types exhibit identical highlight response, indicating lack of material-aware rendering or post-processing

phase24GateInput.detectionMethod: Phase 2.2 material evidence: specularHighlightRatio + specularSharpness + surfaceVariation cross-referenced with IR-declared material categories
phase24GateInput.threshold: If specular response variance across declared material types < threshold, flag as plastic-uniform
phase24GateInput.rejectionAction: DEMERIT for material authenticity dimension; requires PBR renderer validation for promotion

antiPatterns.name: Systemic Temporal Sterility
antiPatterns.description: All images excessively clean and perfect; no weathering, patina, moss, water stains, cracks, material erosion, or any evidence of temporal entropy. This is the most systemic deficiency across the entire 22-image sample.

diagnosticEvidence.evidence: Laplacian variance concentrated in architectural edges rather than surface texture; no high-frequency noise clusters indicative of weathering; color histograms show uniform saturation without patina-induced desaturation patches

antiPatterns.impact: This is the single largest contributor to all 7 evaluated samples remaining in the decorative layer (10-15) rather than reaching the structural layer (≥16). Chinese aesthetic structural authenticity requires material evidence of time (包浆, 风化, 水痕) as a core dimension.

phase24GateInput.detectionMethod: Phase 2.2 material evidence: microSurfaceHighFrequencyVariance + roughnessSpatialVariance + colorVariationSpatialGradient + timeTraceDetectability
phase24GateInput.threshold: If timeTraceDetectability < 0.1 AND surfaceVariation < threshold, flag as temporally-sterile
phase24GateInput.rejectionAction: BLOCK for structural-layer golden case promotion; ALLOW as decorative reference; requires temporal texture augmentation for structural promotion

antiPatterns.remediationDirection: Future golden case acquisition must specifically seek assets with: moss growth, water staining, weathered wood grain, eroded stone surfaces, rust on metal fittings, cracked tile, patina on bronze. These are not 'defects' but core evidence of temporal authenticity in Chinese aesthetics.

summary.note: These diagnostic findings will feed into Phase 2.4 Anti-Pattern Gate design, but the gate implementation must be grounded in Phase 1 Anti-Pattern Grammar + Phase 2.2 Observable Evidence, not directly instantiated from this report.
